tools.name: createSoundiizImportLink
tools.description: Create a temporary 24-hour Soundiiz import link for 1 to 200 supplied tracks. Show the exact returned shareUrl, including query parameters, and expiry. Preserve a requested destination and omit it otherwise. The user reviews the tracks and completes the transfer in Soundiiz. Omit unknown album or IS

tools.name: listSoundiizImportDestinations
tools.description: List configured destinations that can currently receive a Soundiiz playlist import link. Use the returned public slug across Soundiiz MCP tools. Existing corenames are also accepted; use corename for an import when slug is null. Does not access an account or check live service health.

tools.name: getSoundiizTransferCompatibility
tools.description: Check transfer and one-way playlist-sync capabilities between two platforms, including Soundiiz storage. Use public slugs, such as spotify and youtube-music, or existing Soundiiz corenames such as ytmusic and soundiiz. Return supported item types and human-readable web guide URLs from the cached pla

tools.name: createSoundiizImportLinkFromUrl
tools.description: Read a public playlist of at most 200 source items from its HTTPS URL and create a 24-hour Soundiiz import link. Supported sources: Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, YouTube, YouTube Music, Qobuz, TIDAL and public Soundiiz playlists. Supported short-link hosts: link.deezer.com, spotify.link,

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "createSoundiizImportLink" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
